title: Free Delivery Threshold, Distance-Based Delivery Charge, and 'Delivery in 10 Mins' Label

requirements.summary: Display delivery charge breakdown on checkout page showing ₹5 fee for orders below ₹51 within 1km, or 'Free Delivery' for orders ₹51 and above
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout page shows a 'Delivery Charge: ₹5' line item when cart total < ₹51 and delivery distance is ≤ 1km.
Checkout page shows 'Free Delivery' when cart total is ₹51 or above.
The grand total displayed on checkout includes the ₹5 delivery charge when applicable.
The existing distance-based delivery fee logic for distances beyond 1km is preserved.

file_operations.description: Update the checkout page to calculate and display the delivery charge breakdown. When the cart subtotal is below ₹51 and the distance is ≤ 1km, show a 'Delivery Charge: ₹5' line item. When the cart subtotal is ₹51 or above, show 'Free Delivery' regardless of distance within 1km. Include the delivery charge in the grand total calculation. Preserve the existing distance-based delivery fee calculation for distances beyond 1km (₹20 per km beyond 1km). The backend method `calculateTotalPrice` returns the total including delivery charges, so parse the response to extract and display the delivery fee component separately before showing the final total.

requirements.summary: Add 'Delivery in 10 Mins' label below product names on all product cards
acceptanceCriteria: Each product card on the shop page shows the text 'Delivery in 10 Mins' immediately below the product name.
The text is styled in a small green font (e.g., text-green-600 text-xs or similar).
The label appears for all products regardless of category.

file_operations.description: Add a small green text label 'Delivery in 10 Mins' directly below the product name in the ProductCard component. Use Tailwind classes such as 'text-green-600 text-xs' to style the label as small green text. Position the label immediately after the product name element and before the category badge, ensuring it appears on all product cards regardless of category.
